package serial

import (
	"errors"
	"testing"
	"testing/synctest"
)

func TestCloseBeforeCompletionCallRetainsSubmissionHandle(t *testing.T) {
	synctest.Test(t, func(t *testing.T) {
		probeReset()
		port, err := Open("SIMULATED", &Mode{BaudRate: 115200})
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		readDone := make(chan error, 1)
		go func() {
			_, err := port.Read(make([]byte, 8))
			readDone <- err
		}()
		<-probeCalls.beforeWait
		closeDone := make(chan error, 1)
		go func() { closeDone <- port.Close() }()
		synctest.Wait()
		closeReturned := false
		var closeErr error
		select {
		case closeErr = <-closeDone:
			closeReturned = true
			t.Error("Close returned before the completion call")
		default:
		}
		close(probeCalls.resume)
		synctest.Wait()
		err = <-readDone
		var portErr *PortError
		if !errors.As(err, &portErr) || portErr.Code() != PortClosed {
			t.Errorf("Read error = %v; want PortClosed", err)
		}
		if !closeReturned {
			closeErr = <-closeDone
		}
		if closeErr != nil {
			t.Errorf("Close: %v", closeErr)
		}
		probeCalls.Lock()
		defer probeCalls.Unlock()
		t.Logf("ReadFile=%d GetOverlappedResult=%d CancelIoEx=%d closes=%d closed-before-wait=%t", probeCalls.submitted, probeCalls.waited, probeCalls.cancelled, probeCalls.closed, probeCalls.closedBeforeWait)
		if probeCalls.submitted != probePortHandle || probeCalls.waited != probeCalls.submitted {
			t.Errorf("completion handle %d differs from submission handle %d", probeCalls.waited, probeCalls.submitted)
		}
		if probeCalls.cancelled != probePortHandle {
			t.Errorf("cancellation handle = %d; want %d", probeCalls.cancelled, probePortHandle)
		}
		if probeCalls.closedBeforeWait || probeCalls.closed != 1 {
			t.Errorf("native close ordering: before completion=%t count=%d", probeCalls.closedBeforeWait, probeCalls.closed)
		}
	})
}
